caseName: Great Atlantic & Pacific Tea Co. v. Federal Trade Commission
caseNameFull: Great Atlantic & Pacific Tea Co., Inc. v. Federal Trade Commission

opinions.text:
C. A. 2d Cir. '[Certiorari granted, 435 U. S. 922.] Motion of Samuel E. Parker et al. for leave to file brief as amici curiae denied. Motion of Small Business Legislative Council for leave to file brief as amicus curiae granted.

Mr. Justice Stevens took no part in the consideration or decision of these motions.
